input: four actual orthographic RGB views encoded by a frozen locally-loaded Mask R-CNN v2 ResNet-50-FPN backbone
target: masked named neckline/front-back-armhole/sleeve-head landmarks, scale metrics, and two-cubic semantic-path formulas
notes: The backbone path is supplied at runtime and must point to a local checkpoint.
An armhole is one role query whose formula contains two child cubic segments.
The first experiment freezes the FPN and trains only the spatial token encoder, role decoder, and heads.
